inputs.reachability_method: grep of apps/api/src for import sites, npm ls <pkg> --all for dependency paths, and manual tracing of each anchor package's own require graph in node_modules for eagerly-vs-never-required transitive vulnerable packages (documented per-advisory below)
inputs.reference: FABLE-REAUDIT.md CR-13 ("1 critical / 14 high / 7 moderate / 2 low counted; reachability triage unrun") and docs/remediation/PACKAGE-GRAPH.yaml verification_gates.VERIFY-DEP

summary.highest_severity_reachable_finding: drizzle-orm (SQL injection via improperly escaped identifiers, direct dependency, used throughout apps/api/src)

raw.note: node apps/api/scripts/wp13-dependency-triage.mjs captured npm audit + npm ls dependency-path evidence (inlined per-advisory below alongside the reachability verdict, which required additional manual tracing the script does not automate -- see method notes per row).

advisories.name: @coinbase/cdp-sdk
advisories.why: apps/api/src/lib/x402-gateway.ts imports createFacilitatorConfig from @coinbase/x402, which requires @coinbase/cdp-sdk/auth. Loaded at boot whenever the x402 gateway module loads.

advisories.name: axios
advisories.why: node_modules/@coinbase/cdp-sdk/_cjs/auth/index.js does `const axiosHooks = __importStar(require('./hooks/axios/index.js'))` -- a static, eager CommonJS require, executed whenever cdp-sdk's /auth subpath loads (which x402-gateway.ts's import chain does at boot).

advisories.name: brace-expansion
advisories.why: lib/log.ts loads @logtail/pino via pino.transport() whenever BETTER_STACK_SOURCE_TOKEN is set, which it is in Railway production per the module's own comment. The package loads in the log-transport worker thread. Caveat: minimatch's specific invocation inside @logtail/node appears to be internal config/glob matching, not fed externally-attacker-controlled input as far as traced -- reachable at the package-load level, practical exploitability not established either way.

advisories.name: c2pa-node
advisories.why: apps/api/src/capabilities/c2pa-inspect.ts imports and calls c2pa-node directly; the capability is registered via registerCapability and is NOT in auto-register.ts's DEACTIVATED map (grep for "c2pa" in that map: zero hits).

advisories.name: drizzle-orm
advisories.why: The ORM used throughout apps/api/src (app.ts, capabilities/*, db/*, lib/guarded-executor.ts, and dozens more). Advisory is SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers -- the highest-severity REACHABLE finding in this triage; the fix is a semver-major bump (0.38.4 -> 0.45.2+) needing its own scoped upgrade session with the DEC-20260504-A regression-test discipline, not performed here.

advisories.name: fast-uri
advisories.path: ajv -> fast-uri (ajv itself: @strale/api -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> ajv-formats -> ajv; also @strale/api -> @x402/extensions -> ajv; also root direct dependency)
advisories.why: ajv is imported directly in apps/api/src/capabilities/screenshot-url.ts, and is also a dependency of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's ajv-formats (used for MCP tool JSON-schema validation, exercised on every tool call) and of @x402/extensions.

advisories.name: form-data
advisories.why: Same eager-require chain as axios above (cdp-sdk/auth/index.js -> hooks/axios/index.js -> axios -> form-data).

advisories.name: hono
advisories.why: The core web framework -- every HTTP request to the API runs through it. Advisories: cookie-name validation bypass in setCookie()/getCookie(), and a toSSG() path-traversal (toSSG is a static-site-generation helper Strale does not appear to call, but setCookie/getCookie are load-bearing for auth). Fix is available and not semver-major; a strong upgrade candidate.

advisories.name: ip-address
advisories.why: apps/api/src/routes/mcp.ts imports only McpServer (server/mcp.js) and WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport (server/webStandardStreamableHttp.js) from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Traced both files' own import graphs in node_modules: webStandardStreamableHttp.js imports only ../types.js; server/mcp.js imports only ./index.js, ./completable.js, ../shared/uriTemplate.js, ../shared/toolNameValidation.js, ../experimental/tasks/mcp-server.js -- none touch server/express.js or server/auth/* (grep for files requiring 'express' inside the SDK found only server/express.js, server/auth/handlers/*, server/auth/router.js, and examples/* -- none reachable from the two files Strale imports). express-rate-limit (and its ip-address dependency) exists only inside the SDK's unused OAuth/express transport.

advisories.name: js-yaml
advisories.path: @strale/api -> js-yaml@4.3.1 (direct, PATCHED, used for manifest parsing at boot per commit 5da32514) AND @strale/api -> c2pa-node -> @changesets/cli -> @manypkg/get-packages -> read-yaml-file -> js-yaml@3.14.2 (vulnerable, nested)
advisories.why: npm ls js-yaml --all shows TWO instances: the direct dependency (4.3.1, deduped, already outside the vulnerable <=3.15.0 range -- this is the one apps/api's own manifest-loading code uses) and a nested 3.14.2 reachable only through @changesets/cli, a release-management CLI tool (invoked via `npx changeset`, never imported by any file under apps/api/src). The vulnerable instance is dev-tooling-only.

advisories.name: path-to-regexp
advisories.why: Same reasoning as ip-address above -- express (and everything under it) lives only in the SDK's unused OAuth/express transport, never imported by apps/api/src/routes/mcp.ts.

advisories.name: sharp
advisories.path: @strale/api -> sharp@0.35.3 (direct, PATCHED per commit 3909dc1e) AND @strale/api -> c2pa-node -> sharp@0.34.3 (vulnerable, nested, c2pa-node's own bundled copy)
advisories.why: c2pa-node bundles its own sharp@0.34.3 internally (separate install from the direct, already-patched sharp@0.35.3). Because c2pa-inspect.ts calls into c2pa-node's own API, any image processing c2pa-node does internally uses ITS OWN sharp copy, not the direct one apps/api imports -- so the vulnerable nested instance is reachable whenever the c2pa-inspect capability runs, despite the direct dependency already being fixed.

advisories.name: shell-quote
advisories.path: @strale/api -> c2pa-node -> npm-run-all -> shell-quote; also @strale/api -> drizzle-kit -> ... -> shell-quote
advisories.why: Both paths are dev/build/CLI tooling: npm-run-all is a package.json script-chaining tool (bundled as one of c2pa-node's own regular dependencies, never imported by c2pa-inspect.ts's actual usage of the c2pa-node public API), and drizzle-kit is the schema-migration CLI (`npx drizzle-kit generate`), never imported by any apps/api/src runtime file. The ONE critical advisory in this audit is not reachable from the running API.

advisories.name: undici
advisories.why: apps/api/src/lib/safe-fetch.ts imports `Agent as UndiciAgent` from undici directly and uses it as the dispatcher for every outbound fetch() capabilities make -- this is the SSRF-containment module (WP0/WP12). A security-critical reachable path; worth prioritizing given the advisory is a TLS-cert-validation bypass and header-injection class.

advisories.name: ws
advisories.why: Traced cdp-sdk/_cjs/auth/index.js's full eager require list: ./hooks/axios/index.js, ./utils/http.js, ./utils/jwt.js, ./utils/ws.js -- none is @solana/kit, and utils/ws.js (a locally-named auth-header helper, not the ws npm package) itself only requires ./http.js and ./jwt.js. The only 'solana' string found anywhere in the /auth subpath's files is a URL-path regex (`/end-users/[^/]+/solana$/`) in utils/http.js, not an import. Strale's x402 rail is Base-mainnet-only per CLAUDE.md; the Solana-specific submodule that would pull in @solana/kit (and therefore ws) is never imported.
